issues.legal_issue: An objector who is clearly notified that a hearing will be available when objections are submitted, but elects to submit written objections by post without appearing, has been given the required opportunity of hearing when those objections are considered.
material_facts: The notice invited the objector to submit objections within the stated period and said that the objector or a representative or advocate would be heard when the objections were produced.
The objector sent written objections by post and did not appear personally or through a representative or advocate to produce them or request a hearing.
The objections were considered and a report was submitted to the government before the acquisition declaration was published.
issues.conclusion: The mandatory hearing requirement was complied with; in these circumstances, the authority was not required to fix a further hearing date, and the acquisition declaration was not invalid for want of a hearing.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5A(2) of the Land Acquisition Act requires the Collector to provide an objector an opportunity to be heard in person or through an authorised person or pleader. The right to a hearing is mandatory, but an objector may choose not to avail himself of it. The Court accepted the principle in Shyam Nandan Prasad v. State of Bihar, (1993) 4 SCC 255. The reliance on Sir Farid Ahmed Abdul Samad v. Municipal Corporation of the City of Ahmedabad, (1976) 3 SCC 719, did not require a further hearing date on these facts. Had the objector appeared and requested a hearing but not been heard, the question would have been different.

rule.if: land_acquisition_objection_challenge and notice_offered_hearing_when_objections_were_produced and objector_sent_objections_by_post and objector_did_not_appear and objections_were_considered

predicates.land_acquisition_objection_challenge: A person challenged an acquisition on the ground that the required opportunity to be heard on objections was not provided.
predicates.notice_offered_hearing_when_objections_w: The authority notified the objector that the objector or a representative or advocate could be heard when the objections were produced.
predicates.objector_sent_objections_by_post: The objector submitted the objections by post rather than producing them in person or through a representative or advocate.
predicates.objector_did_not_appear: The objector did not appear, personally or through a representative or advocate, to produce the objections or seek a hearing.
predicates.objections_were_considered: The authority considered the written objections before proceeding with the acquisition.

issues.definition: When an acquisition challenge concerns the hearing on objections, and the notice offers a hearing upon production of objections, the objector sends the objections by post without appearing, and the authority considers them, the hearing requirement is satisfied.

issues.legal_issue: The one-year period for publishing an acquisition declaration is calculated from the last relevant publication of the acquisition notification, excluding time during which further proceedings were stayed by a court.
material_facts: The objector challenged the declaration as having been published more than one year after the acquisition notification.
The Court found that the declaration had been published within one year of the last date of local publication of the acquisition notification.
issues.conclusion: The declaration was published within the applicable one-year period, so the timing challenge failed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 6(2) of the Land Acquisition Act requires the declaration to be published within one year of publication of the notification under Section 4(1). The period is reckoned from the last relevant date of publication, and time during which further proceedings were stayed by the High Court is excluded.

predicates.acquisition_declaration_timeliness_chall: A person challenged an acquisition declaration on the ground that it was published outside the applicable time limit.
predicates.declaration_within_counted_year: The declaration was published within one year after the last relevant publication of the acquisition notification, excluding any period during which further proceedings were stayed by a court.

issues.definition: When an acquisition declaration is challenged as late but was published within the counted year after the last relevant notification publication, the declaration was published timely.
